_what: THE WORLD OF BLUEFIN -- the chapter that replaces act II's front in the YouTube release: 2001: A Space Odyssey's Dawn of Man sequence (Warner Classics upload 5NShEY1ScSY) cut down to its story beats, then the Nightwish Darwin clip (renders/efmb-front.mkv 4.0 -> 70.4667, clean), hard cut, each part keeping its own audio. The cut list is EDIT_2001 in scripts/build_world_of_bluefin.py: source 86.0 -> 504.295 compressed from 6:43 to 2:05 (silent vistas and repeated foraging dropped, one shot or sound event kept per beat), then 504.295 -> 679.2333 untouched (owner: '7m-11m is finished'). The rest of Endless Forms Most Beautiful becomes a standalone.
_version: 2 -- 2026-09-25: first segment compressed to the story beats (owner: 'compress the first segment ... cut out the monotonous ones for modern audiences, ensure we are capturing 2001 story beats as outlined by the book'); title swap as v1
